title: Where do real heroes work?
objectives: use indefinite articles a/an with occupations

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Where do real heroes work?.
Welcome to today's lesson: Where do real heroes work?! Today we will practice how to use indefinite articles a/an with occupations.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Where do real heroes work?:
use indefinite articles a/an with occupations; describe essential community workplaces

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: teacher, doctor, nurse, engineer, manager, hospital

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: My sister is a nurse at the local hospital. She is a real hero in our community.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Real heroes work in our community. A doctor works in a hospital. A nurse and an engineer help people.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Describe what real heroes in your city do and where they work.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: use indefinite articles a/an with occupations, describe essential community workplaces.
